biw_news.title: Leapmotor Unveils LEAP 5.0 Architecture and CTC 3.0 Battery Integration
biw_news.summary: Leapmotor introduced its LEAP 5.0 Mobile Space Architecture alongside CTC 3.0 Cell-to-Chassis battery integration. The platform maximizes interior spatial efficiency while optimizing chassis rigidity and reducing low-voltage system complexity.

biw_news.title: Aston Martin DB12 S Focuses on Weight Reduction and Dynamic Performance
biw_news.summary: Aston Martin's DB12 S super tourer achieves a structural weight reduction of up to 50kg compared to standard variants. The weight-saving engineering is combined with targeted chassis revisions to optimize vehicle dynamics.

biw_news.title: Volkswagen SSP EV Platform Delays Push Audi A4 e-tron Production to 2029
biw_news.summary: Production of the all-electric Audi A4 e-tron has been rescheduled to 2029 due to software and development bottlenecks with Volkswagen Group's Scalable Systems Platform (SSP). The delay affects the rollout of next-generation EV body structures.

biw_news.title: Volkswagen Unveils Mission Efficiency Aero Concept Based on XL1 Legacy
biw_news.summary: Volkswagen revealed the Mission Efficiency concept, an extreme aerodynamic development built upon the ID.Polo platform architecture. Drawing engineering principles from the ultra-light XL1, the study focuses on body drag reduction and lightweight structures.

biw_news.title: Audi Begins Assembly Line Production of New Compact A2 e-tron
biw_news.summary: Audi has officially started manufacturing the compact A2 e-tron EV at its Ingolstadt facility. The assembly line integration highlights optimized body production processes designed for high manufacturing efficiency.

biw_news.title: Ford Validates Vehicle Hardware and Body Integrity in Extreme Thermal Testing
biw_news.summary: Ford engineers are subjecting pre-production vehicles to severe high-temperature load testing in the Arizona desert. The program evaluates structural thermal expansion, body joint integrity, and hardware durability under high heat stress.
